local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local input=require('openmw.input')
local frame=0
local sampleFrame=nil
local held=false
local gapAligned=false
local locked=nil
local lastDead=-1
local function aim(p)
 local fromCamera=camera.getViewTransform():inverse()
 local origin=fromCamera:apply(util.vector3(0,0,0))
 local forward=fromCamera:apply(util.vector3(0,0,-1))-origin
 local d=p-origin
 local yaw=math.atan2(forward.y*d.x-forward.x*d.y,forward.x*d.x+forward.y*d.y)
 local targetPitch=math.atan2(d.z,math.sqrt(d.x*d.x+d.y*d.y))
 local currentPitch=math.atan2(forward.z,math.sqrt(forward.x*forward.x+forward.y*forward.y))
 local pitch=currentPitch-targetPitch
 local function units(angle) return math.max(-8192,math.min(8192,math.floor(angle*5120+.5))) end
 local gain=camera.getMode()==camera.MODE.FirstPerson and 1 or 2
 return units(yaw*gain),units(pitch)
end
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function()
 frame=frame+1
 local down=input.isKeyPressed(input.KEY.F7)
 if down and not held then sampleFrame=frame+3 end
 if not down then sampleFrame=nil end
 held=down
 local settled=sampleFrame and frame>=sampleFrame
 if settled then print('Early camera settled') end
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self) and Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current>0,'Player died during early rat group')
 if frame==5 then print('Joined wall encounter ready') end
 local target,distance,dead=nil,nil,0
 for _,id in ipairs({{0x37e40,0x37e41,0x37e42}}) do
  local actor=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',id))
  if actor and actor:isValid() then
   if Actor.isDead(actor) then dead=dead+1 elseif actor.enabled then
    assert(actor.position.z > -1200,'Required live wall rat below tutorial floor: '..tostring(id)..' '..tostring(actor.position))
    local dist=(actor.position-self.position):length()
    if not distance or dist<distance then target,distance=actor,dist end
   end
  end
 end
 if locked and locked:isValid() and locked.enabled and not Actor.isDead(locked)
  and (locked.position-self.position):length()<=160 then
  target=locked distance=(locked.position-self.position):length()
 else locked=target end
 if dead~=lastDead then lastDead=dead print('Joined early rat dead count '..dead) end
 if dead>=3 then print('Joined early rat group cleared') end
 local gap=util.vector3(265,3190,self.position.z)
 if not gapAligned and (gap-self.position):length()<18 then gapAligned=true print('Joined wall gap aligned') end
 local crossing=gapAligned and util.vector3(600,3190,self.position.z+100) or util.vector3(265,3190,self.position.z+100)
 local approach=crossing
 if target and (distance<=160 or self.position.x>=560) then approach=target.position+util.vector3(0,0,35)
 elseif not target and self.position.x>=560 then approach=util.vector3(1700,3260,self.position.z+100) end
 local ax,ay=aim(approach)
 print(string.format('Joined early approach aim x=%d y=%d',ax,ay))
 if distance and distance<=160 then print('Joined early foe near') end
 local cx,cy=aim(crossing)
 print(string.format('Joined wall crossing aim x=%d y=%d',cx,cy))
 if target then
  local rx,ry=aim(target.position+util.vector3(0,0,35))
  print(string.format('Joined early rat aim x=%d y=%d distance=%.2f target=%s',rx,ry,distance,tostring(target.recordId)))
  if settled and math.abs(rx)<400 and math.abs(ry)<200 then print('Joined early rat facing') end
 else print('Joined early rat aim x=0 y=0 distance=0 target=none') end
 if self.position.x>=560 then print('Joined wall crossed') end
 if self.position.x>=560 and math.abs(self.position.y-3190)<40 then print('Joined wall exit ready') end
 if frame%15==0 then print('Joined early Player '..tostring(self.position)..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current..' dead='..dead) end
end}}}}
